name: chatverse
description: 事件驱动的 AI 世界编排与创作框架

scripts.build:types: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-source && npm run build -w @chatverse/group-package && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-benchmark
scripts.cvwb:e2e:server: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-benchmark && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-server && node scripts/world-server-live-e2e.mjs
scripts.cvwb:e2e:galgame: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-server && node scripts/galgame-live-e2e.mjs
scripts.conversation:e2e: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-server && node scripts/conversation-live-e2e.mjs
scripts.audit: npm run audit:architecture && npm run audit:exports
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-source && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && concurrently -k -n core,source,authoring,server "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev -w @chatverse/world-source" "npm run dev -w @chatverse/world-authoring" "npm run dev:server:app"
scripts.dev:world: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-source && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && concurrently -k -n core,source,authoring,server,web "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev -w @chatverse/world-source" "npm run dev -w @chatverse/world-authoring" "npm run dev:server:app" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.cvwb:live: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-benchmark && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-run-lab && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-server && node scripts/cvwb-live.mjs
scripts.cvwb:marathon: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-source && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-authoring && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-benchmark && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-run-lab && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-server && node scripts/cvwb-product-marathon.mjs
scripts.cvwb:plan-beat: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-source && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-server && node scripts/plan-beat-quality-live.mjs
scripts.cvwb:narrator-probe: npm run build -w @chatverse/core && npm run build -w @chatverse/world-server && node scripts/narrator-beat-probe.mjs
